title: Kursdorfer Weg, Leipzig
description:
🌟 Private Room for Rent in a Beautiful 3-Bedroom Shared Apartment in Leipzig – Schönau 🌟

Address: Kursdorfer Weg 4, 04205 Leipzig
District: Schönau (City District: West Leipzig)

🏡 About the Apartment

Welcome to your new home in Leipzig-Schönau, one of Leipzig’s most green, well-connected, and peaceful districts.
This furnished 3-bedroom apartment offers a private room in a shared flat (WG) with 3 other friendly housemates. Perfect for students, interns, and working professionals who want a clean, comfortable, and sociable living environment.

Apartment Features:

Fully furnished private room with bed, mattress, pillows, blanket, and bedsheets

Shared kitchen, washroom, and hallway with 3 other tenants

Modern appliances: refrigerator, washing machine, oven, Wi-Fi router, and vacuum cleaner

Equipped kitchen: plates, bowls, cutlery, pots, pans, utensils, and storage racks

All bills included (electricity, heating, water, internet – fair use policy applies)

Anmeldung possible (official city registration)

Individual rental contract in your name

Broadcasting fee (ARD/ZDF) not included

One-time processing fee: €130 (waived for returning tenants)

Minimum stay: 3 months

Notice period: 1 month after the minimum stay

📍 Excellent Location – Schönau, Leipzig

The apartment is ideally situated in Leipzig-Schönau, a super-central and safe residential area. It’s just a few minutes’ walk from the Schönauer Park, one of the city’s most beloved green spaces, perfect for jogging, picnics, and relaxation.

Public Transport Connectivity:

Schönauer Ring Train Station – only a short walk away, offering direct connections to the Leipzig Hauptbahnhof (Central Station), Leipzig University, HTWK Leipzig, and even Leipzig/Halle Airport.

Multiple tram and bus lines connect you quickly to all parts of Leipzig.

Whether you work or study in the city center, the commute is smooth, quick, and affordable.

🌿 Lifestyle and Surroundings

Schönau offers the perfect blend of urban convenience and natural beauty.
You’ll find everything you need nearby:

Supermarkets & shopping centers within walking distance

Cafés, restaurants, and bakeries offering diverse cuisines

Lakes and parks for outdoor leisure (Schönauer Park, Kulkwitzer See)

Gyms, entertainment spots, and cultural venues just a short ride away

It’s an area popular with young professionals, students, and families, known for being quiet, safe, and well-maintained.

🧑‍🎓 Who Can Apply

Students, interns, or working professionals

All nationalities, genders, and age groups welcome

Clean, respectful, and community-minded tenants preferred

🔑 Summary

✅ Private furnished room in a 3-bedroom shared apartment
✅ Prime location – Kursdorfer Weg 4, Leipzig-Schönau
✅ Excellent transport links (Schönauer Ring station nearby)
✅ All utilities included (fair use)
✅ Anmeldung possible
✅ Minimum stay: 3 months | Notice: 1 month
✅ Safe, green, and vibrant neighborhood

✨ Why Choose This Apartment?

If you’re looking for a beautiful, convenient, and affordable place to stay in Leipzig, this apartment is the perfect choice. Enjoy the comfort of a private room, friendly housemates, and the benefits of living in one of Leipzig’s best-connected districts, close to parks, shops, and universities.

title: Schönauer Ring, Leipzig
description:
A small room, a big home - and perhaps some interesting people you would otherwise never have met.

We are offering a furnished private room in our comfortable 4-room apartment in Leipzig-Schönau.
I am a theatre director and artist, and I live here with my teenage daughter. We are looking for an open-minded, friendly and independent person who enjoys living in a home that is a little different from a typical shared flat.

Available initially for 6 - 12 months, with the possibility of extending if it works well for everyone.

## Your room

The room is approximately 11 m2. It is small, but well equipped and designed to be comfortable both for living and studying/working.

It includes:

* 90 × 200 cm bed, extendable for occasional guests
* height-adjustable desk
* office chair
* two drawer units
* chest of drawers and clothes rail
* wall mirror
* bookshelves
* private TV, with the option to participate in the Netflix subscription
* private attached clothes dryer
* large window
* plants
* lockable room
* Wi-Fi

A **private printer** can also be provided on request.

You have access to the entire apartment, including:

* living room
* fully equipped kitchen
* bathroom
* balcony
* cellar
* bicycle storage

## About us

My daughter enjoys reading, theatre, guitar, crafts, films and board games. **She is also learning Spanish and would be happy to have more opportunities to hear and speak the language.**

I am increasingly working with storytelling, AI, VR and immersive media.

We are curious, culturally interested people who enjoy good conversations and meeting people from different backgrounds.

At the same time, privacy is important to us. Everyone should have their own space and their own life.

We are not looking for a classic Zweck-WG where everyone simply shares the rent and disappears behind their bedroom door.

If you feel like cooking together, watching a film, playing a board game, having a coffee or talking about an interesting project - great.
If you have had a long day and simply want to close your door and have time for yourself - equally great.

We would like our home to feel warm and welcoming, but without obligations or pressure.

## Who might enjoy living here?

We are particularly interested in meeting people from creative and technology-related fields, for example:

* AI / AI creation
* VR / XR
* Unreal Engine / Unity
* motion design
* sound design
* storytelling / screenwriting
* games
* film / animation
* marketing / community
* cultural and innovation projects

You absolutely do not have to work in one of these fields.
For us, personality is much more important: openness, respect, curiosity and a willingness to communicate.

**International and English-speaking tenants are very welcome.**
We also speak German, English, Slovak, Czech and Polish. My daughter learns Spanish too.

## An important part of our home

A friendly and respectful relationship with my daughter is very important to us. We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys talking to and interacting with a teenager - not someone who merely tolerates the fact that a child lives here.

There is no expectation that you become part of our family or take on any responsibility for her. We simply want someone who is naturally comfortable around young people.

## The location

The apartment is in **Leipzig-Schönau**, a quiet and green residential area with good everyday infrastructure.

* Lidl and Norma are nearby
* Kaufland is about 10 minutes on foot
* Allee-Center is about 12 minutes on foot
* Kulkwitzer See is about 10 minutes by bicycle
* tram stop about 9 minutes from the apartment
* trams run approximately every 10 minutes
* Leipzig city centre is easily accessible by public transport
* by bicycle, the city centre takes approximately 20 - 30 minutes

The bicycle route into central Leipzig is particularly nice, with a large part of the way running through green areas and along the **Karl-Heine-Kanal**.

There is also **free parking directly in front of the building**.

## Rent

**420€ rent + 75 € monthly flat-rate additional costs**

The additional costs include:
* internet
* electricity
* water
* broadcasting fee
* furniture

Not included are: 
* towels/bedding (can be rent upon request) 
* cosmetic & hygiene products (shampoo, shower gel, washing powder...)
* overnight guests

**Total: 495 € per month**

**Deposit: 500 €**

Initial rental period: ** 3-12 months**, with the possibility of extending by mutual agreement.

## House rules

We are a **non-smoking household**.

No:
* parties in the apartment
* excessive alcohol consumption
* pets

If you think this could be a good fit for you, please tell us a little about yourself:

**What are you doing in Leipzig? Why are you coming to the city? What are you looking for in a home and in a shared living situation?**

We are looking forward to getting to know you.
